notes.title: A major multiplayer update is live in Trash Sailors!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings brave sailors![/h3]

[h3]We have some really exciting news, a major update is live in Trash Sailors to enable much smoother and exhilarating rides for your multiplayer parties![/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6YrBxwg.gif[/img]

[h3]Play it with the update now![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132030/Trash_Sailors/

[h3]Check out the main changes in this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] This update will dramatically increase the multiplayer stability for different regions while making the connection conditions much less relevant to your multiplayer experience! 
[*] Quality of life improvement has been applied;
[*] Public matches are available now! If you have been looking forward to mingling with other sailors and playing not only with your friends but with random players online, now’s the time to start the game!
[/list]

We understand that a lot of you sailors have been supporting us since our launch and that means more than anything to us. We have worked hard in the past few months for this really exciting news and hope this update elevates your multiplayer experience to a whole new level. Please feel free to let us know how you like the update in our community channels as usual!

notes.title: Update - 31/01/2022
notes.content:
Hello Sailors,

Today we have a quick update addressing various improvements and bug fixes.

[list]
[*] Improvements to online multiplayer and specifically those with slow a connection
[*] Synchronization fixes: flying players, missing treasures and obstacles, bugged animations should now appear
[*] Fixed a major bug with the tutorial on 2nd level
[*] Update to various controls issues (Keyboard and Controller)
[*] Steam Remote Play is now working correctly
[*] Update to audio including quiet and missing sounds.
[*] Mary's attacks have been made much easier to use
[*] Lobby canceling issues now fixed.
[/list]

Thank you all for your patience, please feel free to share your thoughts in our social channels.

notes.title: An update is live to fix the previous issues for 4 players online!
notes.content:

[b]We have been working to fix that and are glad to let you know that a fresh update is live now![/b]

[h3]Please update the game and try it out:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132030/Trash_Sailors/

[h3]In this update we have:[/h3]
[h3][olist]
[*] Improved loading time
[*] Fixed critical issues for 4 players
[*] Fixed issues with missing obstacles for online players
[/olist][/h3]

Please feel free to update the game and try again! In the meantime, we are still constantly working on improving the online Co-Op experience so please let us know how this new update work for you! Thank you in advance!

notes.title: tinyBuild Connect Starts NOW and we have a NEW DEMO!
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy, sailors![/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PJ9CHCY.gif[/img]

From the hottest jungle to the icy Arctic, dangers lurk in the water and opportunities await your discovery. Embark on your cruise today to appreciate different seascapes, gather trash (or as we see them in the Trash Sailors world, resources), fuel the tank, fight the enemies and sail as far as you can! 

We will drop a major update with [b]three brand new levels[/b] for the Trash Sailors demo today and you can get a front-row seat to check the gameplay in [b]tinyBuild Connect[/b]!

[h2]🔴Tune in to tinyBuild Connect![/h2]
[previewyoutube=HHl9nBYXWVU;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]👀If you can't wait already, let's take this opportunity to go through what's new in this new demo!👀[/h2]

[h2]Watch the trailer:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=RAGUc_B98xw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]- 🌴 Jungle Level[/h3] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WemQIni.gif[/img]

Watch out and stay alert as threats come over your head and below your raft! Dodge the pulling tentacles, aim your fire at the enemies jumping from the trees and send the crocodiles back to the waves!

[h3]- ❄️Snow level[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nnowvZE.gif[/img]

We know the summer just ended, but it is never too early to get festive and celebrate the holiday season!

[h3]- 🎈 New challenges and enemies[/h3] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q2FSGwm.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Nq5yXx8.gif[/img]

You can never be too relaxed on the trashy flows. Keep your eyes out for crows, sharks, torpedoes, shooting air-balloons or even vomiting pipes. The enemies are creative so you need to work hard too, captain!

[h3]- Accessibility Settings![/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GeDqXa1.gif[/img]

Need a chill ride to relax after a long day? Flexibly adjust the Accessibility Settings to get rid of unwanted threats and enjoy the cool ocean breeze. Customize the accessibility to an extent that you are most comfortable with and define your own nautical legend!

[hr][/hr]

Last but not least, we know you are still waiting for the most important piece of information - [b]The Release Date.[/b] While we cannot provide you a specific date just yet, we want to thank you all for patiently waiting and supporting us! We have high hopes to release the game soon on all platforms while we need some extra time to improve the multiplayer experience and ensure we can deliver a 100/100 work to you guys. In the meantime, we will work our best to deliver all latest news and updates in the near future!

[h3]Ready to dive into the new demo now? Visit our store page and update now! Don't forget to [b]WISHLIST[/b] so you can get all future release news and updates![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132030/Trash_Sailors/

[h3]In the meantime, come hang out at our social pages![/h3]

[i][list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/X2GvEfp]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/trashsailors/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/TrashSailors]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/trashsailors/]Instagram[/url]
[/list][/i]

That's all for today, see you in the game and stay tuned for more news!
